Spacious 4-Bedroom Family Home | Approx. 135 sq.m. | Built 2005

Number 5 Carraig Mór is a beautifully presented four-bedroom semi-detached residence offering generous living accommodation, modern comforts, and a superb location just 30 minutes from Galway City.

Set within a well-established development, the property is approached by a private driveway providing ample off-street parking, while the attractive natural stone façade creates an immediate sense of warmth and character.

Inside, the home is spacious, and thoughtfully laid out to suit modern family living. The accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hall, a large open-plan kitchen and dining area ideal for everyday living and entertaining, a separate sitting room featuring an attractive open fire, a practical utility room, and a convenient downstairs guest bathroom.

Upstairs, the property offers four well-proportioned bedrooms, including a spacious main bedroom with en suite, together with a well-appointed family bathroom. The layout provides excellent flexibility for growing families, remote working, or guest accommodation.

Additional features include oil-fired central heating, excellent storage throughout, and a private rear garden perfect for outdoor enjoyment.

Ideally positioned, the property is just 20 minutes from Athenry and approximately 30 minutes from Galway City, with convenient access via the motorway network, making it an excellent choice for commuters seeking spacious family living within easy reach of the city.
